concerns.text: SC-004 requires a measurable margin of ≥5% with p < 0.05 to confirm 1B outperforms 7B. Task T030c generates a report stating the result but lacks a task to programmatically evaluate the margin and p-value against SC-004 thresholds in code. The spec requires the system to 'identify if any strategy exists' based on these thresholds, but no task implements this logic or verification step.

FR-008 requires inferring failure modes for every configuration. Tasks T023 (US2 execution) and T027 (US3 execution) do not explicitly invoke the `classify_failure` function (T017a) within the execution loop. The classifier is only applied post-hoc in T017b/c/d. If execution fails or the post-hoc tasks are skipped, the 'failure_mode' field required by FR-005/FR-008 will be missing from the primary JSONL outputs.

FR-001 and Spec Edge Cases require the system to fail with 'Insufficient Context-Bound Data' if the filtered dataset drops below a minimum threshold. Task T012c filters and writes the file, while T040 (KS-test) and T041 (Independence Check) are separate tasks. There is no explicit task to check the instance count and halt the pipeline if the threshold is not met, risking the experiment proceeding with invalid data.

FR-002 specifies a 'CPU-runnable 1B-parameter model'. Task T015 only 'configures' the runner, and T026c implements the generic runner. There is no explicit task to verify that the specific 1B model (e.g., Llama-3-1B) loads and executes successfully on the target hardware within the 60-minute budget before the main experiment runs, risking a runtime failure that blocks the entire study.

Task T021 implements 'diff-aware sliding window' using `difflib` to identify 'changed hunks relative to the issue description'. The plan and spec clarify that the 'diff-aware' strategy is a 'Heuristic Keyword-Proxy' because the issue description does not contain a code diff. T021's description contradicts the available data (issue text vs. code state) and should be corrected to use keywords in file content as per the plan's 'Construct Validity Audit'.

Task T039 requires checksumming `data/results.csv` and `data/intermediate/baseline_run.jsonl`. These artifacts are generated in Phase 3 and Phase 5 respectively. T039 is scheduled in Phase 2 (Foundational) before the data exists, creating a logical dependency error where the task cannot be executed or verified at the time it is scheduled.
